deploy-bot: rollout completed for eu-prod (eu4) -> model=my-embed:v2.4.0, rollout=40%. Starting post-deploy smoke/synth checks now.

deploy-bot: smoke results (first pass): healthchecks=OK, synth-embed-p95=420ms (baseline 120ms), synth-fail-rate=3.2% (threshold 1%). KV cache miss rate +27% on eu4.

sasha k: seeing the same in the dashboard — a few user-facing errors traced to embed endpoint, p50 fine but p95/tail is bad. synth failures show "kv-miss -> fallback" in stack.

ben t: is this localized to eu4 or global?

deploy-bot: metric slice by region: eu4 abnormal. eu1/eu2/us are within baseline.

alice r: noted we changed quant/config for this model in the eu rollout bundle (awq-8bit) — could be cache packing interaction. kvcache evictions spiked at rollout start.

morgan d: recommend pausing further rollout and pinning eu4 back to v2.3.1 while we investigate. We don't need a full global rollback.

priya s: agree. Can we run a one-off longer-sequence synthetic to reproduce? I'll post the curl to trigger the synth job.

priya s: ```
curl -X POST https://synth-runner.internal/api/run 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SYNTH_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"region":"eu4","scenario":"embed-long","trials":50}'
```

ben t: also check the kvcache metrics around pack window and the kernel logs. Might be an inference runtime eviction under higher mem pressure.

elena (oncall): I'm on it, will attach flamegraphs and kvcache histograms. Holding rollout now. :eyes:

deploy-bot: "rollout paused" — eu4 halted at 40%. Canary weight reverted to 0% for eu4.

morgan d: action: pin eu4 -> my-embed:v2.3.1. Command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu4 --model my-embed:v2.3.1`

alice r: filing follow-up ticket INC-2345 for deep-dive (root cause, quantization + kvcache interactions). Scheduling postmortem tomorrow 09:30 PT.

elena (oncall): ran synth-run; reproduced tail increase locally. uploading traces to the incident thread now.

ben t: ack — rollback/pin sounds good. Please paste the command output when done. :thumbsup:

morgan d: I'll execute the pin now and confirm when traffic is back to v2.3.1 on eu4.

deploy-bot: pin successful. eu4 now serving my-embed:v2.3.1, rollout=100% in region. Monitoring for 15m.

sasha k: seeing p95 drop back to ~130ms already. Will keep monitoring and add any anomalous traces to INC-2345.

ben t: thanks team — good call to avoid global rollback. Follow-up deep-dive tomorrow.
